results.title: A webhook with no token is refused
results.detail: no X-LP-Token -> 403

results.title: A webhook with the wrong token is refused
results.detail: wrong X-LP-Token -> 403

results.title: Every inbound endpoint is authenticated, not just the lead ones
results.detail: all 12 endpoints refuse an unauthenticated call, including the three mocks

results.title: A malformed JSON body does not take the workflow down
results.detail: truncated JSON -> 422, no lead created

results.title: An empty body is handled, not crashed on
results.detail: empty body -> 202 {"ok":false,"received":1,"accepted":0,"duplicates":0,"quarantined":1,"ignored":0,"lead_uids":[],"incomplete":[],"errors"

results.title: An unknown event type is rejected with a reason
results.detail: type "teleport" -> ok:false, "type must be one of reply, opt_out, booking, close, sales_action"

results.title: An event with no lead_uid is rejected
results.detail: missing lead_uid -> ok:false, "lead_uid is required"

results.title: An event for a lead that does not exist is a 404, not a crash
results.detail: unknown lead -> status 404, "no lead with id LP-19990101-DEADBEEF"

results.title: An approval with an invalid decision is rejected
results.detail: decision "maybe" -> ok:false, "decision must be approve or reject"

results.title: A second approval on the same lead is refused, not silently applied
results.detail: reject applied, then approve refused ("this lead was already rejected by manager@example.com. Rever"); state stayed rejected

results.title: A WhatsApp delivery-status callback is acknowledged and ignored
results.detail: status callback -> 202, lead count unchanged at 19

results.title: An excluded vertical is hard-disqualified whatever else it scores
results.detail: $50k urgent enquiry, gambling vertical -> score 0, unqualified, "excluded vertical, hard disqualify"

results.title: Job-seeker language is penalised, not qualified
results.detail: penalty -20 applied, final score 58 -> nurture

results.title: A disposable inbox costs points and says so
results.detail: mailinator.com -> -10 points, "throwaway inbox"

results.title: An Arabic enquiry is parsed, scored and routed like any other
results.detail: Arabic name and body preserved; service=automation and urgency=immediate matched from Arabic; Odoo #65

results.title: A Nurture lead gets the nurture cadence, not the qualified one
results.detail: score 52 -> nurture; 3 follow-ups due at roughly +2d, +7d, +21d (rule: 2/7/21)

results.title: A Qualified lead is assigned, armed with an SLA, and confirmed
results.detail: owner sales-01 (rung 1), SLA at +1800s, confirmation sent, Odoo #67 carries the score and reason

results.title: A 50 KB message is truncated rather than crashing or storing whole
results.detail: 52000 chars in -> free_text capped at 4000, lead completed normally

results.title: Hostile strings in every field are stored as data, never executed
results.detail: injection payloads stored as inert text, control characters stripped, Odoo #69 created normally

results.title: A CSV over the row cap is refused with the limit named, not half-imported
results.detail: 260 rows in -> 0 imported, refused with the limit named: "260 rows exceeds the 200-row synchronous limit. Split the file, or use the documented async import path."

results.title: A CSV with a BOM, CRLF and quoted commas parses correctly
results.detail: BOM stripped, CRLF handled, quoted commas and an embedded newline preserved: "Hassan, Mahmoud" / "Delta Clinics, LLC"

results.title: An import row with attested consent records where consent came from
results.detail: consent=granted, consent_source=import_attested - the lawful basis is recorded per lead, not assumed

results.title: Replaying a dead letter that does not exist is a 404
results.detail: unknown dlq_id -> 404, "no dead letter with id dlq-does-not-exist-83617611"

results.title: Replaying with no dlq_id at all is a 400
results.detail: missing dlq_id -> 400, "dlq_id is required"

results.title: A malformed override_json is refused instead of half-applied
results.detail: bad override -> 400, and the dead letter stayed "open" rather than being marked handled

results.title: A dead letter already handled is refused a second time
results.detail: already replayed -> 409, "this dead letter is already replayed"

results.title: A permanent Odoo error is classified permanent and never retried
results.detail: the credential-death injector returns a true 401 ("Simulated bad or expired credential"); classification of 401 as permanent+critical is covered by scripts/test-errors.js (dlq rows: 9)

results.title: The ops endpoint returns every metric the brief asks for
results.detail: all six reported - processed 29, qualified 10, duplicates 5, failed 1, manual 1, SLA 1

results.title: The public ops payload does not leak internal addresses
results.detail: manager_email and odoo credentials absent from the 2092-byte public payload

results.title: Every lead this suite created has a complete, readable audit trail
results.detail: 11 leads checked, every one traceable from intake to CRM write, every row carrying its execution id

results.title: The live tables match the schema the code is built from
results.detail: 8 tables, 91 columns, every one matching the definition the workflows are generated from

results.title: Nothing errored on the instance during this run that should not have
results.detail: all 11 workflows: zero unexpected errored executions since this suite started
